mapper.select: SELECT MAX(WarehsCode) FROM shopwizard.tCmpWarehs WHERE WarehsCode LIKE CONCAT(#{value}, 'W%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopwizard.tCmpWarehs ( WarehsCode, WarehsName, AdjustPeriodCode, LoginId, Passwd, MngrName, PhoneNo, MobileNo, FaxNo, Email, PasswdChangeDate, SvcCode, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate, ChangeId, ChangeName, ChangeDate ) VALUES ( #{warehsCode}, #{warehsName}, #{adjustPeriodCode}, #{loginId}, #{passwd}, #{mngrName}, #{phoneNo}, #{mobileNo}, #{faxNo}, #{email}, NOW(), #{svcCode}, #{state}, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW(), #{changeId}, #{changeName}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE shopwizard.tCmpWarehs SET WarehsName = #{warehsName}, AdjustPeriodCode = #{adjustPeriodCode}, LoginId = #{loginId}, MngrName = #{mngrName}, PhoneNo = #{phoneNo}, MobileNo = #{mobileNo}, FaxNo = #{faxNo}, Email = #{email}, SvcCode = #{svcCode}, State = #{state}, Remark = #{remark}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE WarehsCode = #{warehsCode}
UPDATE shopwizard.tCmpWarehs SET Passwd = #{passwd}, PasswdChangeDate = NOW(), ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE WarehsCode = #{warehsCode}
